title: PDI vapor source-temperature domain check
trigger: F-AHL26D preregistered temperatures include -5 C. SWAP authority confirms tsoil is degrees C and accepts negative values.
decision_rule: If the authoritative formula is non-finite or non-positive for an allowed negative-C soil temperature, classify that part of F-AHL26D as upstream source-semantics blocked. Do not alter Kvap physics inside F-AHL.
